messages.text: Heads up: seeing SanctionsScreen p99 latency spike, calls timing out at the 5s client limit since ~14:52. Error rate around 18% and climbing. Opening this as SEV3 for now.
Confirming from my side. Two outbound payment holds on my queue are stuck waiting on a screening response. Nothing is failing hard yet, just sitting there.
Is this related? KYCPipeline onboarding batch shows 9 cases stuck in 'screening pending' since mid afternoon. Nothing from settlements is blocked, just flagging.
Yes, same root. KYCPipeline calls SanctionsScreen synchronously, so those will retry once we recover. Bumping to SEV2 since onboarding and payment holds are both affected.
Joining. Looking at the SanctionsScreen pods now. Connection pool to the list-match index looks saturated, active connections pinned at the max of 50.
Possibly my deploy. I pushed the watchlist refresh job at 14:45 and it does a full reindex instead of incremental. It could be hogging the pool.
That lines up with the timing. Travis, can you pause the refresh job? Don't roll back the deploy yet, we want the list data to stay current.
Paused. The reindex was at about 60% so it will need to restart later. Lookups should free up connections now.
p99 coming down, now 2.1s and error rate is down to 4%. Still watching, the retry backlog from callers is probably inflating things.
Both held payments just cleared screening and released. Thanks. No wires missed their cutoff.
KYC stuck cases are draining too, 6 of 9 done. Will check the remaining 3 when the batch finishes.
Error rate at 0%, p99 back to about 400ms. Dropping to SEV3 monitoring. Total impact window was roughly 40 minutes, 14:52 to 15:32.
Root cause: the refresh job's full reindex competed with live lookups for the same connection pool. Fix plan is incremental updates only, plus a separate pool for batch jobs.
I'll put up the PR tonight with the incremental logic and the dedicated pool config. I will also add a guard so the job can't run during business hours without sign-off.
All 9 KYC cases are through now. Nothing left in the pending state, so I'm good on my end.
Resolving this incident. I'll add an alert on pool utilization above 80% for SanctionsScreen, and a follow-up ticket for the post-incident review is linked in the channel topic.
